definitions.gloss: to be lazy, to slack off

definitions.explanation: To fail to do what one should.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|なま}ける。
{怠|なま}けて⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{怠|なま}けずに⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧した⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}てた→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: As a result of practicing every day without slacking off, I was able to win the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|なま}ける。
⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|なま}けていたら⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧になった。
examples.english: I neglected cleaning and the room became a mess.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怠|なま}けると、あとで⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you neglect managing your health, it will cause serious problems later.

notes:
{怠|なま}ける means to be lazy or slack off, with negative connotations.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Usually intransitive: {怠|なま}けている (being lazy)
- With object: {仕事|しごと}を{怠|なま}ける (to slack off from work)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {怠|なま}けてばかりいる: to always be slacking off
- {勉強|べんきょう}を{怠|なま}ける: to neglect one's studies
- {怠|なま}けずに{働|はたら}く: to work without slacking

RELATED:
- {怠|なま}け{者|もの}: lazy person, slacker
- {怠惰|たいだ}: laziness, indolence (noun/na-adj)
- {怠|おこた}る: to neglect (more formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- さぼる: to skip, play hooky (more colloquial, often for specific occasions)
- ぐうたらする: to loaf around (casual)
